title: Previews
intro: Links to what agents made: mockups, documents and apps they started. A private preview opens only for you, a public one for anyone with the link. Each expires on its own.
empty: No previews yet. Ask an agent to publish a mockup or a document, or to start an app, and its link shows up here.

toasts.public: {title} is public: anyone with the link can open it.

confirmPublic.title: Make {title} public?
confirmPublic.description: Anyone with the link can open it without signing in, until it expires or you take it down.

confirmTakeDown.title: Take down {title}?
confirmTakeDown.description: The link stops working at once, and a copy of files is deleted. The agent can publish it again.

notFound.title: Preview not found
notFound.body: This link does not exist or has expired.

notRunning.title: The app is not running
notRunning.body: The app behind this preview has stopped. Ask the agent to start it again.

denied.title: Access denied
denied.body: This access link is no longer valid. Open the preview again from Abotica.

errors.notFound: This preview no longer exists or has expired.
